title: Abbas bulaata hai
body:
Abbas bulaata hai
<<DIVIDER>>
(Dargaahe alamdaar) x5
(Ya babe hawaaij meri tawkeer barha de, Abbas kate haathon se taqdeer bana de) x2
Zehra se wafadari dunya ko sikhata he
<<MINI>>
(Parcham ka parehra ye) x2 lehra ke bata he
(Abbas bulata hai) x3
(Parcham ka parehra ye) x2 lehra ke bata he
(Abbas bulata hai) x3
<<DIVIDER>>
Dargaahe abulfazlil abbas ke saaye mein
Tafreeq nahin koi apne mein paraye mein
(Jo bhi yahaan aata he) x2 khali nahin jaata he
<<MINI>>
(Abbas bulata hai) x5
<<DIVIDER>>
Be aas marizon ko dunya ke ghareebon ko
Miskinon ko yateemon ko roti huwe aankhon ko
(Har tute huwe dil ki) x2 ye aas bandha ta he
<<MINI>>
(Abbas bulata hai) x5
<<DIVIDER>>
Haidar ke malangon ki is dar pe qataarein hein
Huron ke farishton ki (is dar pe qataarein hein) x2
(Jis jis ka bulawa he) x2 dora chala ata he
<<MINI>>
(Abbas bulata hai) x5
<<DIVIDER>>
Who maula qadam ho ya shahbaaz ki nagri ho
Matam jahaan hota ho majlis jahan hoti ho
(Dene ke liye pursa) x2 zahra ko jo aata he
<<MINI>>
(Abbas bulata hai) x5
<<DIVIDER>>
Mashhad ho najaf ho ya makka ho baqiyya ho
Who karbobala ho ya shahzaadi ka roza ho
(Dunya ka koi zaair) x2 jab bhi yahaan aata he
<<MINI>>
(Abbas bulata hai) x5
<<DIVIDER>>
Bechain he ghabrake khaime mein tehelta he
Kya jurm kiya aisa kyun haathon ko malta he
(Ay hur teri kismat ka) x2 taara ye bata ta he
<<MINI>>
(Abbas bulata hai) x5
<<DIVIDER>>
Girte huwe parcham ko dekha shahe wala ne
Zainab se kaha ro kar abbas ke maula ne
(Hum jaate hein darya par) x2 dil doobta jaata he
<<MINI>>
(Abbas bulata hai) x5
<<DIVIDER>>
Tum sogaye darya par dekho to zara uth kar
Shabbir ko ghere hein no lakh ka ye lashkar
(Jab teer koi dil par) x2 aaqa ke rakha ta he
<<MINI>>
(Abbas bulata hai) x5
<<DIVIDER>>
"Rehan" ki "sarwar" ki maula se wafaaein hein
Abbas ke roze pe nawha liye aaye hein
(Shahzaadi sakina ka) x2 nawha jo sunata he
<<MINI>>
(Abbas bulata hai) x5
